evidence_tree: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

step_1_item_magnitude.claim: Black Cleaver's Carve is 6% armor reduction per stack, 5 stacks max = 30% cap.
step_1_item_magnitude.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
step_1_item_magnitude.legal_range_for_this_leaf: fraction in {0.06, 0.12, 0.18, 0.24, 0.30} (or any 0.06k, k<=5 under an averaged-stack model); 0.18 = 3 stacks x 6% is legal and under the 30% cap

step_2_engine_stack_model.claim: The documented averaged-stack model reproduces 0.18 exactly for a 6-hit participant.
step_2_engine_stack_model.quote: Black Cleaver average stacks (`ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction`): the established model uses a fixed `0.8·max_stacks` constant (with a `hits/2` short-fight branch).
step_2_engine_stack_model.arithmetic: short-fight branch: stacks = min(5, hits/2); hits = 6 -> 3 stacks -> 3 x 0.06 = 0.18. (Long-fight constant 0.8 x 5 = 4 stacks -> 0.24; cap 0.30.) So 0.18 is a value the documented model actually produces, not an artifact.

step_3_factor_consistency.claim: factor 1.11 is the exact 100/(100+R) amplification of an 18% armor reduction against a ~121-128 armor target, so the leaf was a coherently computed number, not stale garbage.
step_3_factor_consistency.source: docs/math-foundations.md §2.1 (m(R) = 100/(100+R)); data/champions.json base+growth armor at level 18 via CLAUDE.md growth formula
step_3_factor_consistency.arithmetic: amp = m(0.82R)/m(R) = (100+R)/(100+0.82R). R=120 -> 1.1089; R=122.5 -> 1.1100; R=125 -> 1.1111. Level-18 armor of canonical bruiser/tank targets computed from data/champions.json: Darius 125.4, Leona 124.6, Malphite 124.2, Braum 120.0, Aatrox 119.6 — all land the factor on 1.11. The fraction and the factor are mutually consistent against a real target.

step_4_who_benefits.claim: Carve is a debuff on the TARGET's armor stat, therefore it applies to every attacker hitting that target, including an allied support who does not own the item. Only penetration is attacker-personal.
sources: data/items.json id 3071 simpleDescription: 'Dealing physical damage to enemy champions reduces their Armor'
data/items.json id 3071 riotDescription: 'Dealing physical damage to champions reduces the target's Armor by 6% for 6 seconds. (stacks 5 times).'

docs/math-foundations.md §2.2: 'reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct): R <- R - r_flat; R <- R·(1 - r_pct/100)' vs 'apply_{armor,magic}_penetration(R, f, p): R <- max(0, R·(1 - p) - f)' — reduction rewrites the target's resistance value itself; penetration is the attacker-side step applied afterwards.

docs/math-foundations.md §2.2: 'Reduction can go negative, and penetration then leaves the negative value untouched' — the two are ontologically separate: reduction lives on the target, penetration on the damage source.
step_4_who_benefits.consequence: For an ally (the coupled support participant) computing physical damage against a target carrying Carve stacks, the correct armor-reduction fraction is the target's current Carve fraction (0.06 x stacks, capped 0.30) — not zero. Deleting the entry asserts 0% reduction, i.e. that the support gains nothing from a debuff sitting on the target's armor stat, which contradicts the item text and the reduction/penetration split above.

correct_value.derivation: fraction = 0.06 x stacks = 0.06 x min(5, hits/2 = 3) = 0.18 (wiki 6%/stack, cap 30%; math-foundations short-fight branch); factor = (100+R)/(100+0.82R) = 1.11 at R ~ 122 (m(R) identity, §2.1). Both reproduce the old leaf exactly; the entry must be PRESENT.

docs/math-foundations.md — §2.1 m(R)=100/(100+R); §2.2 reduce_resistance vs apply_penetration ordering and ownership; §2.3 item 2 Black Cleaver average-stack model (0.8·max_stacks, hits/2 short-fight branch)
residual_uncertainty: The oracle cannot see sibling entries [0]/[1] or the scenario's roster definition (golden baseline lives under scripts/, which this runbook forbids). Two conditions would flip the verdict to new_value_correct: (a) 'support' denotes a second enemy target that the Black Cleaver holder never dealt physical damage to, so it legitimately carries no Carve stacks; or (b) entries [0]/[1] are themselves 'Black Cleaver — Carve' duplicates and [2] was a triplicate. Both are argued against by the leaf's own internal consistency: a coherent factor of 1.11 implies the reduction was being applied against a real ~122-armor target that was in fact under Carve, and a per-item unique passive would not legitimately produce three co-existing entries. On the evidence available, removing a target-side armor_reduction_percent from an ally's ledger understates the support's physical damage.
